content.value: A digital encryption system uses keys based on modular arithmetic. Let the encryption (10) [CO1] be computed using a public key, n = 77, an integer message, m, and the encryption rule: $c = m ^ { 5 }$ (mod 77).
i) Compute the encryption of message, m-= 12.
ii) Briefly explain why modular arithmetic ensures data security in simple cryptosystem.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2025
